title: Strong reading skills may help teens resist misinformation
summary_en: Students with stronger reading skills are better able to spot misinformation online — and that may be especially important for teenagers from disadvantaged backgrounds, according to a new study from the Brown School.
title_cn: Strong reading skills may help teens resist misinformation

title: WashU Leadership Week expands programming, partnerships
summary_en: WashU Leadership Week, hosted by the Bauer Leaders Academy, offers workshops and panel discussions for students, faculty and staff. Programming includes leadership development sessions for faculty and staff plus the annual “She Leads” Symposium.
title_cn: WashU Leadership Week expands programming, partnerships

title: New building blocks expand functions of photonic chips
summary_en: McKelvey Engineering researchers Sang-Hoon Bae and Lan Yang collaborated to establish a framework for heterogeneous integrated photonic chips, enabling multiple functions on a single chip with greater freedom to combine materials and design devices.
title_cn: New building blocks expand functions of photonic chips
